player_prompt.intro:
O wewe Mchezaji {player_id} na SimpleTak.
Pa mataba, mawe yako yamonuka kama '{player_stone}' na mawe ya mpinzani yamonuka kama '{opponent_stone}'.

Pa wakati wako, chagua seli moja tupu (kwa nambari yake) na weka kibao chako kule.
Kwa mfano, '[12]' huweka kibao chako kwenye seli 12.

Lengo lako ni kuunda njia ya mawe yako inayounganisha kingo mbili za mataba (juu-chini au kushoto-kulia).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Mutindu ya kutinda kele mbote ve
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Nambari ya selu isiyo sahihi {cell_num}. Inabidi iwe kati ya 0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Selu {cell_num} ikabwana. Khumbela selu iliyo taka.

action.placement: Mwana {current_player_id} wakabidila symbol yawo ({symbol}) mu selu {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Mchezaji {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') aliunganisha kingo mbili za mataba!
outcome.draw: Bo me fuluka na bantu, mpi yo kele kiteso mosi!
